name: Japandi Kitchen Counter
description: Straight rectangular fitted kitchen assembly combining light-wood base and overhead cabinets, multiple cupboard and drawer segments, a speckled stone-effect worktop and backsplash, an integrated two-zone cooktop, a built-in oven at the right end and under-cabinet lighting. Includes all cabinetry, work surfaces and cooking appliances as one footprint along a single wall; the sink and refrigerator are separate.

name: Industrial L-Shaped Kitchen Counter
description: L-shaped fitted kitchen assembly along two perpendicular walls, combining multiple connected counter segments, dark base and overhead cabinets, wood accent panels, a brick-effect backsplash, an integrated kitchen sink and faucets, a cooktop, a built-in oven, and an adjacent tall refrigerator cabinet into one corner footprint. Includes open display shelving, under-cabinet lighting and the visible countertop accessories. Place the complete kitchen once for the connected counters, sink, cooking appliances and refrigerator.

name: Industrial Double Bowl Kitchen Sink Cabinet Unit
description: Straight rectangular kitchen sink cabinet assembly with a dark stone-effect countertop, two adjacent inset metal sink bowls, one shared high-arched faucet, dark base cupboards and drawers, and a recessed plinth. Includes both bowls, the faucet, continuous worktop and all base storage as one footprint; the cooktop, oven, refrigerator and wall cabinets are separate.

name: Japandi Double Bowl Kitchen Sink Cabinet Unit
description: Straight rectangular kitchen sink cabinet assembly with a pale speckled stone-effect countertop, two adjacent inset metal sink bowls, one shared high-arched faucet, light-wood base cupboards and drawers, and a recessed plinth. Includes both bowls, the faucet, continuous worktop and all base storage as one footprint; the cooktop, oven, refrigerator and wall cabinets are separate.

name: Japandi L-Shaped Kitchen Counter
description: L-shaped fitted kitchen assembly along two perpendicular walls, combining multiple connected counter segments, light-wood upper cabinets, pale base cupboards and drawers, an integrated kitchen sink and faucet, a cooktop, a built-in oven, and an adjacent tall refrigerator cabinet into one corner footprint. Includes the worktops, backsplash, open display shelf, under-cabinet lighting and visible countertop accessories. Place the complete kitchen once for the connected counters, sink, cooking appliances and refrigerator.

name: Pub Table
description: Long, narrow rectangular pub table with a thick dark wood plank top, black metal apron and frame, four straight square-section legs, a long lower foot rail and crossbars joining the end legs. Includes the complete tabletop and supporting frame as one freestanding bar-height table; stools, seating, cabinets, sinks and appliances are separate.
